description: Deploy debugging with one durable lesson, a one-off formatting request, and progress narration
transcript:
USER: the new /memory endpoint returns 403 in prod but works locally, can you figure out why?
AGENT: [runs curl against prod: 403 from nginx, not from the app]
AGENT: [reads deploy/nginx.conf] The container's nginx has an explicit location allowlist; /memory isn't in it. Every new endpoint has to be added there or nginx rejects it before it reaches the app.
AGENT: [adds location /memory, rebuilds, redeploys with `just deploy-prod`] 200 now.
USER: great. don't bother with a changelog entry this time, it's a hotfix.
AGENT: Skipped the changelog. I also bumped the image tag to 2026-10-01.
USER: thanks

expect.name: nginx allowlist needs each new endpoint
